hello.label: Hello
hello.description: Place flat dominant hand at forehead, palm facing out, move outward in a slight salute.

thank you.label: Thank You
thank you.description: Touch fingers of flat dominant hand to chin/lips, then move forward toward the person.

thanks.label: Thanks
thanks.description: Touch fingers of flat dominant hand to chin/lips, then move forward toward the person.

yes.label: Yes
yes.description: Make an S-fist and nod it up and down like a head nodding.

no.label: No
no.description: Tap index and middle fingers together with thumb rapidly.

help.label: Help
help.description: Place dominant A-fist thumbs up on top of flat non-dominant palm, lift together.

water.label: Water
water.description: Tap index finger of W-handshape to chin twice.

food.label: Food
food.description: Tap flat O-handshape against lips twice.

eat.label: Eat
eat.description: Tap flat O-handshape against lips twice.

please.label: Please
please.description: Rub flat dominant palm in circular motion over chest.

sorry.label: Sorry
sorry.description: Rub S-fist in circular motion over chest.

my name is.label: My Name Is
my name is.description: Pat chest with flat hand (MY), tap double-index H/N hands (NAME).

good morning.label: Good Morning
good morning.description: Touch chin with flat hand (GOOD), raise non-dominant hand while arc up dominant arm (MORNING).

nice to meet you.label: Nice To Meet You
nice to meet you.description: Slide top hand over bottom hand (NICE), bring index fingers together (MEET YOU).

i love you.label: I Love You
i love you.description: Extend thumb, index, and pinky finger simultaneously (ILY handshape).

friend.label: Friend
friend.description: Hook index fingers together, flip and hook the opposite way.

family.label: Family
family.description: Touch thumbs of F-handshapes together, circle around until pinkies touch.

stop.label: Stop
stop.description: Chop edge of dominant open hand firmly into non-dominant palm.

go.label: Go
go.description: Point both index fingers forward away from body.

where.label: Where
where.description: Hold index finger up (1-handshape) and wag side to side.

what.label: What
what.description: Hold open hands upward and shake palms back and forth.

why.label: Why
why.description: Touch forehead with flat hand, pull away into Y-handshape.

how.label: How
how.description: Place bent knuckles together, roll hands forward outward.

understand.label: Understand
understand.description: Flick index finger up from fist near forehead like a light bulb.

deaf.label: Deaf
deaf.description: Touch index finger to cheek near ear, then move to cheek near mouth.

hearing.label: Hearing
hearing.description: Rotate horizontal index finger forward near lips.

sign.label: Sign
sign.description: Rotate 1-handshapes around each other in backwards circles.

doctor.label: Doctor
doctor.description: Tap bent D/M fingertips on non-dominant wrist pulse point.

hospital.label: Hospital
hospital.description: Draw an H-cross on upper non-dominant arm with H-handshape.

home.label: Home
home.description: Touch flat O-handshape to cheek near mouth, then cheek near ear.

peace.label: Peace
peace.description: Form a V-sign with index and middle fingers extended high.

good.label: Good
good.description: Touch fingers to lips with flat hand and lower into non-dominant palm.
